title: Ko Riiwaaɗo e Asamaan
intro: Tagɗo sirlu ina darii e ŋoral tagoore e jaɓde. Daartol maɓɓe ko mawnikinaare nde alaa ko nanndi e mum, e ƴattaade yamiroore Alla. Suɓngo maɓɓe ina rewi e kala yonta, ina wonta jarribo kala ruuhu jibinaaɗo e oo aduna. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude oo gaño duumotooɗo?
clues: Miɗo tawtoraa kewu baawɗo wonde fof, nde tagoore hesere sosaa e loopal, rokka nguurndam e Pooftol Yurmeende.
Miin e hoore am, mi ardii e tagoore wootere ɓuuɓnde, nde nanndaani e oon tagoore ɓuuɓnde.
Yamiroore yaltinaama e am nde cikku-mi ko les station am.
Manngu ɓuuɓtii e nder am, mi salii ɗooftaade ndeen yamiroore.
Leelgol haa ñalawma toɗɗaaɗo rokkaama, mbele miɗo waawa jokkude faandaare am bayyinaande ngam majjude woɗɓe.
Ko miin woni gaño bayyinaaɗo e kala yahooɓe e leydi, ɓuuɓnoowo fenaande e luulndaade ɗum en e laawol peewal.

arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ سُلْطَـٰنٌ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
verse: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord. (16:99)
